title: Technical Project Manager (Software Engineering Team)
description:
Job Summary 
 Notion Press runs a technology platform used by tens of thousands of authors and readers. Behind it sits an in-house product and engineering team building web applications, internal tools, integrations and a growing amount of AI assisted automation. We are currently rebuilding how that engineering team runs, with a new delivery pipeline and a new pod structure, and we need someone to run projects through it. Every piece of engineering work we take on, whether it is a new product feature, a research bet, a third party integration or a critical production bug, moves through one defined pipeline. Intake, research, technical definition, proof of concept, UI, production planning, build, demo, deployment, and then measurement once it is live. Every stage has an owner, and every project has success metrics agreed before a line of code is written. We are looking for the person who holds all of that together. You will pick up a project at intake and stay with it until the 90 day post release metrics are in. You will sit in the CTOs office rather than inside one delivery team, which means you see everything that is in flight, across every project, all the time. If you like being the person who knows exactly where every build stands, this is a very good seat. 
 
 Job Type 
 Full time 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Own the tracker. Every item, every stage, every timeline, every owner, in Jira Product Discovery and the sprint backlog. Our rule is simple: if it is not in the tracker, it is not happening. Keeping that true is your job. Hold the stage gates. Nothing moves forward until it has met its exit criteria. PoC results tested against the metrics we defined upfront, UI signed off, production plan complete, end user sign off before anything is called done. You are the person who says not yet, this is incomplete, including to engineers more senior than you. Run the daily scrum. You run it, with the CTO in the room. Blockers surface the same day rather than at the end of a sprint. Run releases. You coordinate deployment planning across development, QA and infrastructure, and you make sure rollback plans exist before anything goes to production. Track and report the metrics. Everything we ship gets measured at 24 hours, 48 hours, 1 week, 30, 60 and 90 days against its defined metrics. You set the cadence for each item, gather the numbers, and give the CTO a clean read so the next decision, whether that is scale it, iterate on it, roll it back or kill it, gets made on evidence rather than instinct. Keep the process healthy. Timesheets, debriefs, documentation. Not glamorous, and the whole system falls apart without it. 
 
 Requirements 
 3 to 6 years managing software projects, as a technical project manager, delivery manager, programme manager or scrum master, inside a software product or engineering team Direct experience running sprints for a team of developers, QA and infrastructure engineers. Your day should already look like standups, grooming, dependency tracking and release coordination. Hands on ownership of a backlog in Jira, Linear or similar, including sprint planning, grooming and dependency tracking A track record of running parallel software workstreams at the same time without losing track of any of them Enough technical grounding to follow a conversation about architecture, APIs, tech stack choices, staging and production environments, and deployment approaches. You will not be writing production code, but you do need to ask the right questions and know when an answer is thin. Comfort with metrics. You can define a measurable success criterion, go and get the number, and report it straight, including when the news is not good. Clear, precise writing. A lot of this role is written communication. The confidence to hold a line. Telling an experienced engineer that something is not ready to move forward is a weekly part of this job. 
 
 Good to have 
 Experience with Jira Product Discovery A background in e-commerce, marketplaces, consumer internet or SaaS platforms An engineering or computer science degree, or a career that started in development or QA Exposure to AI or ML assisted product work Scrum or Agile certification

description:

 Larsen & Toubro Ltd, commonly known as L&T, is an Indian multinational conglomerate company, with business interests in engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, information technology and financial services, headquartered in Mumbai. The company is counted among world's top five construction companies. 
 The L&T Group comprises of 93 subsidiaries, 5 associate companies, 27 joint ventures and 35 jointly held operations, operating across basic and heavy engineering, construction, realty, manufacturing of capital goods, information technology, and financial services. 
 Job Role: Internal Auditor 
 This role is based out of Chennai. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Audit Planning: Develop and implement risk-based internal audit plans for project operations. Identify key risks associated with project execution, including financial, operational, and compliance risks. Design audit scopes, objectives, and timelines for reviewing projects. 
 Internal Control Evaluation: Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of internal controls related to project activities, including procurement, budgeting, financial reporting, and resource allocation. Identify weaknesses in controls and recommend improvements. 
 Project Financial Audits: Review financial records of projects to ensure accuracy and compliance with accounting standards. Conduct audits of project budgets, funding, cost allocation, and expenditure. Monitor adherence to contractual obligations and project funding agreements. 
 Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure that project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies. Identify potential risks in project management processes and suggest strategies to mitigate them. Conduct audits related to regulatory compliance, contract management, and external reporting requirements. 
 Project Performance Audits: Evaluate the performance of projects, ensuring that objectives are being met within budget, timeline, and scope. Review the efficiency of project resource utilization (staff, equipment, etc.). Conduct post-implementation audits to assess the success and sustainability of projects. 
 Reporting and Recommendations: Prepare audit reports with findings, conclusions, and recommendations for management. Present audit results to project managers, senior leadership, and other stakeholders. Follow up on audit recommendations to ensure corrective actions are implemented. 
 Advisory and Improvement Initiatives: Provide consultative support to project teams to strengthen internal controls and enhance risk management strategies. Offer insights for process improvements and opportunities for cost-saving and efficiency in project management. 
 Coordination and Collaboration: Collaborate with project managers, finance teams, and other stakeholders to gather audit evidence and ensure transparency. Work closely with external auditors where necessary, providing required documentation and insights. 
 Documentation and Record-Keeping: Maintain thorough documentation of audit processes, findings, and follow-up actions. Ensure all audit work is conducted in accordance with established standards, guidelines, and best practices. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications: 
 Education: CA Compulsory 
 Experience: Proven experience (7-12 years) in internal auditing, preferably within project-driven environments (e.g., construction, IT, engineering). Familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, PRINCE2, or PMP is advantageous. 
 Technical Skills: Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, audit techniques, and risk management principles. Proficient in audit software and ERP systems. Strong knowledge of accounting standards (GAAP, IFRS) and regulatory requirements. 
 Work Environment: This position will require travel to project sites for on-site audits (2 weeks in a month). The auditor should be comfortable working in a dynamic project environment with multiple ongoing initiatives.
